result.title: Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
result.summary: We study which training and calibration data help three open models solve ARC-AGI-2 tasks when the solver runs offline on four L4 GPUs for at most 12 hours. We compare data offline on public tasks and report 189 runs on the 120 hidden semi-private tasks. For the NVARC Qwen3-4B grid model, we built a corpus of 12,000 executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 tasks; a rule is admitted only if its behaviour on a fixed probe set differs from that of every admitted rule, and a task only if its pairs refute a shortlist of nearest competing rules and defeat 12 shortcut solvers. Continued fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling raised the semi-private score from 28.96 (mean of the released model) to 33.06 (mean of five runs, best 34.86); no checkpoint trained with synthetic tasks, even all 95,993 of them, improved on the real-task model. For the Qwen3.8-27B reasoning model, we fine-tuned on 1,036 of its own reasoning traces with correct final answers and compared sets that add traces of other models and synthetic tasks. With an inference procedure built around the model (a thinking cap enforced in the serving engine, a Python program checked on the demonstrations after each answer, a long first attempt per input), the score rose from 26.81 to 44.03, the level the ARC Prize Foundation measured for the base model without a time limit (42.36); most of the gain came from the inference procedure. For the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model (125B parameters, 6B active), GPU memory limited concurrency. Pruning from 512 to 384 experts per layer by router-weighted activation saliency grew the key-value cache from 0.55M to 1.39M tokens; a 296-expert list adapted with ARC routing statistics, keeping experts for program tokens, plus an FP8 indexer cache, reached 1.96M. With a tool that checks programs, the model scored 56.67, our best result.

AI.brief_summary: 在四张 L4、离线 12 小时的约束下，比较规则语料、自身推理轨迹与合成任务等训练／校准数据，以及「思考上限」、答题后程序校验等推理流程对三个开源模型 ARC-AGI-2 成绩的影响，并报告按路由统计剪枝 MoE 专家以扩展 KV cache 的做法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其长首答＋思考上限＋程序校验的推理流程，以及按路由统计控制专家与缓存容量，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、证据验证和缓存／注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响提供可核查线索；但研究任务是 ARC 网格题而非视觉 latent 推理，联系需较多核查。
